note: Rural campground 5 km from Picture Butte and about 20 minutes from Lethbridge, across the road from a 27-hole golf course with a licensed restaurant. Weekly rates; monthly and seasonal stays by arrangement with the manager. Fresh water comes from the shower house rather than the sites. Mostly long-stay and out-of-town work crews; overnight sites are booked by phone and can fill. --Claude
summary: Operator site (redesigned 2026, pricing page modified 2026-05-28) read: C$40 power / C$45 power+sewer a day plus GST, 30 A everywhere, sewer at sites 8-15, no water hookups, 6 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/laundry/WiFi/dump, phone or form booking. Fees high 45 -> 40 with a C$5 sewer surcharge. Google 4.4/34. Long-stay character: reviews say most sites are full-timers/workers; nightly share unmeasurable (no engine).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: price C$40 + GST (power), C$45 (power & sewer) a day, posted on the operator's pricing page (modified 2026-05-28) - well under C$69; no gateway needed. LONG-STAY (report, not a drop call): (1) nights sold to the public with no application - yes, by phone/email/form; (2) nightly rate posted - yes, C$40/day plus weekly C$240; (3) no standing minimum stated; (4) share of sites sold nightly - UNMEASURABLE (no booking engine; site count not posted - imagery shows roughly 30-35 pads). Seasonal/worker evidence: the operator's banner reads 'Now booking seasonal and overnight stays. Contact us for availability.' and 'Monthly or Seasonal Check with Manager for opportunity and availability.'; Google reviews quoted on the operator's own site: Blake McCallum (about a year ago) 'overall the campground was very quiet due to most of the sites being full-time campers'; Travis Pontarolo 'Majority of the ppl staying are all put of town workers. Fills up fast'. Other reviews (William Wiley, a year ago, 'We had site 3 with electric'; Marion Redpath 'We stayed overnight on our way back') describe overnight stays. Imagery shows nearly every pad occupied by a trailer/RV, consistent with mostly long-stay use. I read this as leaning long-stay but passing tests 1-3 with a posted nightly rate; test 4 cannot be measured. With Google at 4.4 it is not an automatic drop; reviewer's call.
